newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gilts down on bond auction announcement.
newsitem.headline: Indian gilts down on bond auction announcement.

text.p: * Indian government security prices down in light Wednesday trade as traders consolidate positions ahead of new bond auction, dealers said.
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) auctions 30 billion rupees of three-year federal government bonds on May 28.
* Dealers said trade was cautious as market players prepared for the auction but there was some selling as some traders prepared to switch stocks and invest in the new bond.
* In latest deals, the 12.69 percent 2002 traded from 100.25 rupees to 100.29 against last traded price of 100.42.
* Treasury bill maturing in April 1998 traded at a yield of 9.4 percent against 9.35, October 1997 bill traded at 8.5 percent and February 1998 bill at 9.17 percent.
